events.title: PIETA support group
events.text: Monthly session for bereaved parents to pray, reflect and break open the Word of God. Face-to-face from 7:30pm to 9:15pm at Catholic Archdiocesan Education Ctr 2 Highland Rd LG-01.

events.title: Treasure #18 Retreat for Young Working Adults
events.text: Stay-in Catholic Encounter Retreat specially for young working adults (ages 21–35) in Singapore. 6 Nov (Fri) 7.45pm - 9 Nov (Mon) 6pm. Venue: St. Francis Xavier Retreat Centre (199 Ponggol Seventeenth Avenue). Retreat fee: $163.50 (incl. 9% GST). Registration: tinyurl.com/oyp-treasure18.

events.title: OYP Outreach for Sec 4 & 5 Students
events.text: OYP welcomes all who are graduating to join us for a time of prayer with the Lord and getting to know fellow Sec 4 & 5 students. Sat, 21 Nov 2026, 10AM - 1PM. Cost: Free! Venue: 55 Waterloo St, Catholic Ctr #08-01. Register: tinyurl.com/SecOutreach26Nov.

events.title: SCDF Responder Plus Programme
events.text: 09:00–12:30 Church of St Stephen; free first aid, CPR-AED and basic firefighting training. Register by 1 October at office,6747 1433 or css.secretariat@catholic.org.sg.

events.title: BREATHE Youth Retreat
events.text: A space to step away, take a breath, and encounter the love of God. Stay-in retreat for 16-30yos on 16-20 Dec. Organised by the Catholic Spirituality Centre (CSC). Registration at bit.ly/breathe4 and closes on 30 Nov.

getting_there.text: Mattar MRT DT25 ExitB, ~6-minute/450m walk via Mattar Road/Sallim Road, back gate beside The Antares. Bus 62/64/100 at Canossa Catholic Primary, Aljunied Road 70029, ~7 minutes to front gate;40/61/63/65/135/154/155/158 opposite Mattar ExitB70231, ~6 minutes to back gate.
Limited church parking. During events/carpark closure use 52A Pipit Road multistorey carpark,360m away.

sacraments.text: Contact parish office for infant baptism; no preparation dates stated.
One year notification required; contact parish office.
Notify priest immediately and discuss funeral services in person before making arrangements with casket company. Wake enquiries Faith Liu.
Office assists urgent sacramental needs; outside normal office route use Faith.

ministries.name: Paradisum Wake Prayer Ministry
ministries.text: Evening prayers in church prayer rooms, funeral parlours or HDB void decks; members respond at short notice. Transport from church provided when needed. Membership enquiry form linked.

ministries.name: Music Ministry
ministries.text: The Rock Saturday 17:30, Cantores Fidei Sunday 09:00, Jubilate Sunday 11:00, plus Sunday 17:30 choir. Join via ministry contact form.

other.text: Weekday eve/day of obligation schedule 06:30 and 19:00; no specific future dates assigned.
